# BotShelf Vampire

> Practical AI-team, trader-tool, workflow and frontier-industry capability building blocks.

## Start
- https://botshelfvampire.com/
- https://botshelfvampire.com/search/
- https://botshelfvampire.com/trading/

## For buyers and builders
- Buyer guide: https://botshelfvampire.com/for-buyers.html
- Seller guide: https://botshelfvampire.com/for-sellers.html

## Core ideas
- Build/remix reusable capabilities instead of only browsing tools.
- Public summaries describe prerequisites, limits and verification state.
- Source/access may require email registration or payment depending on the item.
- Runtime verification is scoped; untested assets remain explicitly untested.

## Machine-readable sources
- Public catalogs and capability manifests should be preferred where available.

## Important
This file is an experimental navigation aid for AI systems. It does not replace robots.txt, sitemap.xml, canonical URLs, structured data, or normal web crawlability.
